explains.name: storefront_count
explains.sql: SELECT count(*)::int AS count FROM "GroupBuy" g WHERE g.status='PUBLISHED' AND NOT g."isArchived" AND g."endAt">$1

explains.name: storefront_product_search_count
explains.sql: SELECT count(*)::int AS count FROM "GroupBuy" g WHERE g.status='PUBLISHED' AND NOT g."isArchived" AND g."endAt">$1 AND (g.title ILIKE $2 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "GroupBuySku" o JOIN "ProductSku" s ON s.id=o."skuId" AND s."isActive" JOIN "Product" p ON p.id=s."productId" AND p."isActive" LEFT JOIN "SkuInventory" i ON i."skuId"=s.id WHERE o."groupBuyId"=g.id AND o."isActive" AND p.name ILIKE $2))

explains.name: storefront_page_card_aggregate
explains.sql:
WITH page AS (SELECT g.* FROM "GroupBuy" g WHERE g.status='PUBLISHED' AND NOT g."isArchived" AND g."endAt">$1 ORDER BY g."publishedAt" DESC,g.id DESC LIMIT 24 OFFSET 0)
      SELECT g.id,g.title,g.slug,g.description,g."startAt",g."endAt",g."isFeatured",g."featuredSort",c.name AS category,
        (SELECT image."imageUrl" FROM "GroupBuyImage" image WHERE image."groupBuyId"=g.id ORDER BY image."sortOrder",image.id LIMIT 1) AS image,
        a."minPrice",COALESCE(a."minPrice"<>a."maxPrice",false) AS "priceVaries",COALESCE(a."soldOut",false) AS "soldOut",
        (g."startAt"<=$1 AND g."endAt">$1 AND COALESCE(a.stocked,false)) AS purchasable
      FROM page g LEFT JOIN "Category" c ON c.id=g."categoryId"
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(o."salePrice") AS "minPrice",max(o."salePrice") AS "maxPrice",
        bool_and(p."skuInventoryEnabled" AND i."skuId" IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(i."onHand"-i.reserved-i.allocated<=0,false)) AS "soldOut",
        bool_or(p."skuInventoryEnabled" AND i."skuId" IS NOT NULL AND i."onHand"-i.reserved-i.allocated>0) AS stocked FROM "GroupBuySku" o JOIN "ProductSku" s ON s.id=o."skuId" AND s."isActive" JOIN "Product" p ON p.id=s."productId" AND p."isActive" LEFT JOIN "SkuInventory" i ON i."skuId"=s.id WHERE o."groupBuyId"=g.id AND o."isActive") a ORDER BY g."publishedAt" DESC,g.id DESC
